specs.title: four explanatory depths, reverse/fast scrolling, type and highlighted recover
hero-only pixel pattern regenerates edge-to-edge and suspends offscreen/hidden
visible fill sweep, press/focus feedback and persistent selected states
Flow normal/interrupted paths and Recovery highlight; accessible tabs/history
Replay shows actual steps with aliases, optional exact facts and untimed interventions
Results comparisons reproduce retained measurements and preserve all filters
FAQ reverses immediately, closes accessibly and opens one answer at a time
reduced motion has a readable static model, immediate FAQ and manual Replay
recording/measurement fetch errors and invalid provenance can recover
desktop accessibility scan of all six pages and both Engine views
